title: Metric freshness
invariant: resolved identities synced within 48h; connected playlist within 24h

probes.name: stale-artist-metrics
probes.message: resolved artist identities not synced for more than 48h
probes.sql: SELECT artist_id, last_synced_at FROM artist_external_identities WHERE resolution_status = 'resolved' AND (last_synced_at IS NULL OR last_synced_at < now() - interval '48 hours')

probes.name: stale-lander-metrics
probes.message: Lander Records Soundcharts metrics older than 48h
probes.sql: SELECT soundcharts_last_synced_at FROM lander_records_integration_settings WHERE soundcharts_artist_uuid <> '' AND (soundcharts_last_synced_at IS NULL OR soundcharts_last_synced_at < now() - interval '48 hours')

probes.name: stale-spotify-releases
probes.message: connected Spotify playlist not synced for more than 24h
probes.sql: SELECT spotify_last_synced_at FROM lander_records_integration_settings WHERE spotify_playlist_id <> '' AND spotify_refresh_token_encrypted <> '' AND (spotify_last_synced_at IS NULL OR spotify_last_synced_at < now() - interval '24 hours')
